# WindBorne API

WindBorne’s API serves the latest forecasts from its cutting-edge forecast [models](https://api.windbornesystems.com/models/available-models/windborne-models) WeatherMesh & MetaMesh, and the latest observations + soundings from its global [constellation](https://api.windbornesystems.com/atlas/version_1/overview) of hundreds of long-duration weather balloons.

×

## Getting Started

Authenticate, then call the API from Python, the command line, or an AI assistant.

[Install, configure, and make your first call](https://api.windbornesystems.com/getting-started) [API keys, headers, and security best practices](https://api.windbornesystems.com/platform/authentication/auth) [Connect an LLM or AI agent to query the API](https://api.windbornesystems.com/platform/integrations/mcp) [Use the API from Python or the command line](https://api.windbornesystems.com/platform/integrations/python-sdk) [Work with JSON, CSV, and gridded data](https://api.windbornesystems.com/platform/data-formats/file-formats) [Connect the API to tools and platforms that support OpenAPI](https://api.windbornesystems.com/platform/integrations/openapi)

## Weather

Forecasts, recent observations, weather events, and climatology for the places you care about.

### Point Forecasts & Context

[Retrieve point-based forecast data](https://api.windbornesystems.com/weather/version_1/point/point-forecast) [Point forecasts with optional observations and climate context](https://api.windbornesystems.com/weather/version_1/context/weather-context)

### External Observations

[Recent surface weather observations from ASOS stations](https://api.windbornesystems.com/weather/version_1/observations/asos)

### Events

[Atmospheric rivers, heatwaves, coldwaves, and fronts tracked through WM-6 forecasts.](https://api.windbornesystems.com/weather/version_1/events/about)

[Events of one type forecast by a model run](https://api.windbornesystems.com/weather/version_1/events/events) [Browse persistent event IDs across runs](https://api.windbornesystems.com/weather/version_1/events/events-index) [One event's forecast for a selected model run](https://api.windbornesystems.com/weather/version_1/events/event-detail) [Available model runs containing an event](https://api.windbornesystems.com/weather/version_1/events/event-init-times) [Events forecast to affect a point](https://api.windbornesystems.com/weather/version_1/events/event-context)

#### Degree Days

[Heating Degree Days by state](https://api.windbornesystems.com/weather/version_1/events/degree-days/hdd) [Cooling Degree Days by state](https://api.windbornesystems.com/weather/version_1/events/degree-days/cdd)

#### Tropical Cyclones

[Storm tracks from all 128 WM-6 ensemble members.](https://api.windbornesystems.com/weather/version_1/events/tropical-cyclones/about)

[Forecasts for all active tropical cyclones](https://api.windbornesystems.com/weather/version_1/events/tropical-cyclones/tropical-cyclones) [Browse the tropical cyclone catalog](https://api.windbornesystems.com/weather/version_1/events/tropical-cyclones/tropical-cyclones-index) [Detailed forecast for one tropical cyclone](https://api.windbornesystems.com/weather/version_1/events/tropical-cyclones/tropical-cyclone-detail) [Available forecast cycles by cyclone](https://api.windbornesystems.com/weather/version_1/events/tropical-cyclones/tropical-cyclone-init-times)

### Climatology

[Average weather by hour for a location](https://api.windbornesystems.com/weather/version_1/climatology/climatology) [Daily climate statistics for a location](https://api.windbornesystems.com/weather/version_1/climatology/climatology-summary)

### Custom Calculations

[Run your own formula on forecast variables over an area or at points.](https://api.windbornesystems.com/weather/version_1/custom-calculations/about)

[Evaluate a calculation over a geographic area](https://api.windbornesystems.com/weather/version_1/custom-calculations/calculate) [Evaluate a calculation at specific coordinates](https://api.windbornesystems.com/weather/version_1/custom-calculations/points) [Select areas that meet a calculation threshold](https://api.windbornesystems.com/weather/version_1/custom-calculations/threshold) [Check a calculation before running it](https://api.windbornesystems.com/weather/version_1/custom-calculations/validate-calculation)

## Models

Output from each forecast model run, by model and initialization time. Use it for analysis and gridded data.

### Model Availability

[Available model run start times](https://api.windbornesystems.com/models/version_1/availability/initialization-times) [Archived model run start times](https://api.windbornesystems.com/models/version_1/availability/archived-initialization-times) [Available variables by model](https://api.windbornesystems.com/models/version_1/availability/variables) [Available forecast hours and generation times](https://api.windbornesystems.com/models/version_1/availability/run-information) [Available calculation times for degree day and tropical cyclone forecasts](https://api.windbornesystems.com/models/version_1/availability/calculation_times) [List of supported station IDs for point forecasts](https://api.windbornesystems.com/models/version_1/availability/available-stations)

### Model Outputs

[Interpolated point forecasts from gridded output](https://api.windbornesystems.com/models/version_1/outputs/interpolated-point-forecast) [Vertical atmospheric profile forecast for a coordinate](https://api.windbornesystems.com/models/version_1/outputs/interpolated-sounding) [Returns a sentence and icon describing weather conditions at a point](https://api.windbornesystems.com/models/version_1/outputs/conditions) [Download gridded forecast data](https://api.windbornesystems.com/models/version_1/outputs/gridded-forecast)

## Atlas

[Where WindBorne balloons are, where they are headed, and what they measured.](https://api.windbornesystems.com/atlas/version_1/overview)

### Positions

[Metadata for all flying GSBs](https://api.windbornesystems.com/atlas/version_1/positions/flying-missions) [Active and historical GSBs with position data](https://api.windbornesystems.com/atlas/version_1/positions/constellation-status) [Launch site metadata](https://api.windbornesystems.com/atlas/version_1/positions/mission-launch-site) [Current location of the GSB](https://api.windbornesystems.com/atlas/version_1/positions/current-location) [Flight path of the GSB](https://api.windbornesystems.com/atlas/version_1/positions/flight-path) [Predicted flight path of the GSB](https://api.windbornesystems.com/atlas/version_1/positions/predicted-flight-path)

### Observations

Balloon measurements as observations, super observations, and soundings.

[Get the atmospheric observations from all flying GSBs](https://api.windbornesystems.com/atlas/version_1/observations/observations) [Get the superobbed atmospheric observations from all flying GSBs](https://api.windbornesystems.com/atlas/version_1/observations/super-observations) [Discover available atmospheric soundings by time, location, and mission](https://api.windbornesystems.com/atlas/version_1/observations/all-soundings) [Retrieve full vertical profile data for a specific sounding](https://api.windbornesystems.com/atlas/version_1/observations/sounding)

## Webhooks

[Get a notification when new forecasts are ready, instead of polling the API.](https://api.windbornesystems.com/webhooks/version_1/overview)

### Manage Webhooks

[Configure a webhook and its subscriptions](https://api.windbornesystems.com/webhooks/version_1/manage/create-webhook) [All of your webhooks, one page at a time](https://api.windbornesystems.com/webhooks/version_1/manage/list-webhooks) [One webhook with all of its subscriptions](https://api.windbornesystems.com/webhooks/version_1/manage/get-webhook) [Change a webhook's URL, name, note, or active state](https://api.windbornesystems.com/webhooks/version_1/manage/update-webhook) [Delete a webhook and all of its subscriptions](https://api.windbornesystems.com/webhooks/version_1/manage/delete-webhook)

### Manage Subscriptions

[Add a subscription to an existing webhook](https://api.windbornesystems.com/webhooks/version_1/subscriptions/add-subscription) [Change one subscription's settings](https://api.windbornesystems.com/webhooks/version_1/subscriptions/update-subscription) [Remove one subscription from a webhook](https://api.windbornesystems.com/webhooks/version_1/subscriptions/delete-subscription)

### Debug

[Send a test delivery for one subscription](https://api.windbornesystems.com/webhooks/version_1/debug/ping-subscription)
